title: Actual fibres and normalized coefficient-correspondence data
statement: For a scheme X and an algebraically closed geometric point x, use the coefficient rings, finite classical local systems, lisse internal modules, representations and actual functors defined in [def-galois-fibre-functor], [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], [def-weil-regular-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback], [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-geometric-point], [pqf-def-locnoeth], [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module], [def-pod-l-adic-representations], [def-pod-ring-scalar-extension], [def-pod-galois-correspondence-data-e4], [def-sfb-coefficient-map], [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars], [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-to-qlbar], [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-map], [def-sfb-padic-subfield-condensed-ring], [def-sfb-padic-int-condensed-ring], [def-sfb-upper-star-from-point], [def-sfb-finite-upper-star], [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms], [def-sfb-modobj-extension-along-iso], [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor], [sk-def-sfb-transport], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Define the additive geometric fibre by actual ringed-topos inverse image and sections at x; constant scalars act by their sheaf scalar endomorphisms. Define Correspondence to consist of a fully faithful representation functor, the exact essential image, and an additive comparison with this fibre preserving its scalar action. Define HasLattice as an embedded lisse integral module whose actual scalar-extension adjoint is invertible. Define IntegralRational and IntegralAlgCl using respectively lattices and finite-field integral models. IntegralNormalization specifies finite classical reductions, their scalar cokernels, their germ-normalized stalk comparisons, equivariant fibre quotient projections, normalized transitions and the limiting fibre cone. TensorCompatible and ScalarCompatible require the pure-tensor formula for the actual maps. Correspondences is the product of the integral, rational and algebraic-closure families. Conclusion is the conjunction of normalization, compatibility, finite free fibres, normal integrality, finite representation fields of definition, and regularity implying normality. All these are exactly the pre-existing declarations extracted verbatim from the item, not constructions chosen from an unproved existence theorem.
